scope: Hexly-only local onboarding of ag-cli; source repository untouched
generationAuthorization: The owner requested ag-cli onboarding with generated Logo and textures on 2026-11-14.
acceptanceAuthorization: Exact-byte owner approval recorded for both light and dark outputs.
publicationAuthorization: Owner authorized R2 upload on 2026-11-15; local review precedes publication.

description.en: Shallow paired conduit channels, rounded elbows and small flange rings press a quiet dispatch route into matte paper.
description.zh: 浅浅的成对管道槽、圆弧弯头与小法兰环压在哑光纸面上，勾勒出安静的派发路径。

design.motif: Pressed paired conduit channels with rounded elbows, flange rings and bolt-seat dimples over brushed micrograin.
design.rationale: Relates the message-dispatch capsule identity to a physical working surface; full-square paper construction matches the family.

purpose.en: Let external CLI bots dispatch tasks to local Antigravity conversations, wait on events and collect structured results and artifacts.
purpose.zh: 让外部 CLI 机器人向本机 Antigravity 会话派发任务、按事件等待并回收结构化结果与产物。
